translation:
Cinnabar (硃砂), musk (麝香), clove (丁香), dark plum flesh (烏梅肉), Sichuan aconite (川烏), kusnezoff aconite (草烏), Chinese angelica (當歸), san nai (三奈, each one qian), frankincense (乳香, three qian), gleditsia (皂角, seven fen). Grind all together into a fine powder, make into pills with mashed single-clove garlic, wrap in silk floss, and insert into the nose. <ins>Ren Shen Zi Jin Dan (人參紫金丹)</ins> (see the fontanel bone injury)
<ins>Su Zi Tao Ren Tang (蘇子桃仁湯)</ins> (see the crown injury)
